139)༄༅/phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i dgongs don snying por dril ba byin rlabs bum bzang bzhugs so/ /140)skyon bral yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i dgongs don snying por dril ba byin rlabs bum bzang bzhugs so// 140)skyon bral yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i// sgrub rgyud bla ma thams cad la// gus pas snying nas rab btud de// sgrub brgyud gdams pa'i bsnyel tho 'bul/ sku rin po che nyid kyis phebs sgo ji ltar bstsal ba'i thugs dam gyi snying po phyag rgya chen po'i zab bzhes snang tshul la/ spyir gang gi lugs ltar gnang kyang don gyi sleb sa khyad ma mchis mod kyang*/ 'on te phyag chen yi ge bzhi pa sngar nas gsan pa'i mthus/ de'i lugs bzhin mdzad na byin rlabs kyi babs bzang bar 'byung ba dang*/ 'di dag gi don ma lus pa 141)dgongs par mnga' zhing phyag dpe sogs kyang los bzhugs mod kyang*/ 'gag don mdor bsdus bsnyel tho tsam du 'bul bar bgyi na/ de la yi ge bzhi'am/ sa bcad bzhi ni/ sems kyi gzhi rtsa bcad pa/ bsgom tshul lam bzhag thabs bstan pa/ lta ba'i gol sa gcod pa/ spyod pa'i lam 'khyer bya tshul dang bzhi las/ dang po la/ sems kyi byung gnas 'gro gsum/ dbyibs kha dog yod med rtag chad kyi mtshan ma'i mtha' la gnas mi gnas sogs kyi brdar sha bcad pa'i tshe yang*/ bsam mno 142)'phreng brgyud kho nas brtag dpyad byed pa ni thun mong ba'i lugs yin gyi/ 'di skabs khyad par ba'i phyag srol la/ lus gnad lta stangs sogs dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ rang sems rang babs su bzhag la/ gnas na gnas mkhan/ gnas sa/ gnas tshul sogs ci 'dra zhig 'dug pa rang rig nyid kyis legs par brtag 'gyu 'phro zhig thol gyi byung na/ 'gyu tshul/ 'gyu mkhan sogs dang*/ pha yul lta bu zhig tu 'gyus na/ sems phar song ba yin nam/ pha yul tshur 'ongs pa yin nam sogs brtag brtag mkhan dang brtag sa yang gcig gam tha dad sogs nan gyis brtags pas/ de dag gang yang ma grub par shes shing*/ ma grub pa'am ma rnyed pa tsam la gzhi rtsa chod par 'dod pa ni grub mtha' gzhan ma'i lugs lags kyang*/

sgrub rgyud rin po che 'di pa'i lugs la/ grub ma 143)grub/ rnyed ma rnyed sogs kyi tha snyad kyang blo las ma 'das tshe/ blo bral gnyug ma lhan skyes kyi ngo bo snang rig stong gsum zung 'jug don gyi gsang mngon sum rjen par rtogs pa dgos par bzhed pa nyid legs shing*/ 'dir dpal ldan mkha' spyod pas mdzad pa'i khrid gzhung las// dang por 'byung pa ka nas dag /bar du gnas pa'i sa yis stong*// mtha' mar 'gro sa rang bzhin med// rang gi ngo bo kha dog dang*// dbyibs dang mtshan ma kun las 'das// ngos bzung mtshon pa kun dang bral// gzhi rtsa gcad de lhag mthong gi /rang ngo rang las sprad par bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dang*/ 'di dag kyang sngar nas go yul yod pa tsam gyis chog par mi bzung bar do gal du 'bad cing*/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla mar gsol ba btab nas nyams len skyon med 144)rgyud la 'char bar rtse gcig gsol 'debs la rems par bya ba ni yi ge bzhi las dang po'i don yin no// de ltar zhag 'ga' zhig nas rang sems gzhi rtsa chod tshe/ gnyis pa sgom gyi bzhag thabs ni zhi gnas yin kyang*/ zhi gnas thun mong ba tsam la mi 'jog par/ gong du gzhi rtsa chod pa'i zung 'jug lhan skyes kyi don de nyid skyong ba yin tshe zhi lhag zung 'brel du grub la/ ji ltar 'jog na/ mkha' spyod zhabs kyis/ sprin dang bral ba'i nyi bzhin bzhag ces shes pa thom po'am bying rgod sogs kyis ma sgribs pa'i sems gsal dwangs 'thon pa dang*/ khyung chen mkha' la lding ltar bzhag ces pas/ tsab tsub dang yengs dogs kyis bsgribs pa ma yin par/ rang babs gu yangs khong glod ngang*// rgya mtsho chen po'i 'jings bzhin bzhag 145)ces/ phra rag gi rnam rtog bskyod pa ltar snang ba'i dus na'ang*/ gzhi'i gnas lugs rang gsal rang rig las ma g.yos pa dang*/ bu chung lha khang mthong bzhin bzhag ces pas/ tshogs drug gi 'char sgo 'gag med gsal ba la/

de dag la 'di ni bzang ngo*/ 'di ni ngan no/ snyam pa la sogs kyi dgag sgrub dang stangs gcod mi bya bar ro mnyam du bzhag mkha' la bya 'phur rjes bzhin bzhag ces rnam rtog ci ltar shar zhing yal yang de dag la sngon rjes btsad pa sogs chu la ri mo 'bri ba lta bu'i don med kyi rtsol ba mi bya bar gnyer med rang yan du bzhag ras bal 'dab ma brdal ltar bzhag ces pas/ lus sems 'jur sgrims bcos las rang la rang bcings mi bya bar/ lhod de/ 'bol le/ lhan 146)ne ba'i ngang las rang sems gsal dwangs phyed par 'jog pa nyid kyis dus 'da' bar bya la/ mdor na/ las dang po pas thog mar ni thun chung grangs mang gi tshul la bslab cing*/ thun mtshams rnams su yang bsgom dus kyi sems dang khyad par 'dug mi 'dug legs par bltas pas/ rim gyis thun mtshams mi dgos par 'gyur ba chos nyid do/ ༈ yi ge gsum pa gol sa gcod pa ni/ mkha' spyod pas/ sangs rgyas chos la re na gol// 'khor ba'i chos la dogs na gol/ zhes pa 'di gnyis ni/ yar sangs rgyas ces bzang bzang po zhig thob tu re bas/ da lta'i rang sems sku gsum dbyer med rang la lhun grub tu ma shes pas sangs rgyas gzhan nas btsal blo dang*/ mar 'khor ba ngan song zhes ngan ngan sdug sdug po zhig phyogs ga shed na yod pa der skye dogs kyi blos/ 'khor 147)'das sems su ma shes shing yul sems tha dad du bzung ba'i gzung 'dzin gyi mtha' la gnas pa ni lta ba'i gol sa dang*/ yang*/ phyi yi snang bar zhen na gol/ zhes/ 'jig rten tha mal ba ltar dngos por 'dzin pa'i blo a 'thas dang*/ mu stegs pa ltar byed pa pos byas par 'dzin pa dang*/ nyan thos pa ltar rdul phran cha bcas su 'dzin pa dang*/ gsang sngags pas lha dang gzhal yas su lta ba yang bden gnyis zung 'jug ma go ba'i bzang zhen sogs dang bral ba zhig dgos la/ nang gi nyams la zhen na gol/ zhes nyams len byas 'bras kyi lam rtags bde gsal mi rtog gam/

rtags bcu dang*/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul lta bu byung na'ang gtad med du bskyur ma shes par/ rang la rang mthong dga' brod rlom sems zhen 'khris kyis bslad 148)na phung tshabs nan ltar che ba dang*/ shes tsam chog par bzung na gol/ zhes bdag gis man ngag zab mo 'di lta bu thos so/ thob bo/ shes so/ bsgoms so/ snyam pa sogs kyis khengs te nyams su ma blangs pas/ don mngon du gegs su gyur pa de lta bu dang*/ dge tshogs khyad du gsod na gol/ zhes stong pa nyid kha khyer tshig gi gdengs bcas te/ rgyu 'bras rten 'brel dang 'dus byas kyi dge ba'am/ mtshan bcas kyi nyams len la bskur pa 'debs shing dor nas/ gzhan dag kyang dge rtsa las zlog par byed pa'i nag po kha 'byams te/ de ltar lta sgom spyod pa'i gol sa de dag tu ma shor bar thabs shes zung 'brel la bslab par bya zhing*/ gzhan dag kyang de lta bu'i lam bzang la gzud par bya'o/ yi ge bzhi pa lam khyer la yang drug 149)ste/ nyin mo snang ba rgya yis gdab/ ces pa ni/ gong gi mnyam bzhag gi don nyid las logs su brjod pa dgos mod kyang*/ thun dang thun bar nam gyi tshe na'ang snang grags rtog tshogs thams cad la rang gsal rang rig gi dran pas sleb thub par bya ba yin la/ nang nub 'dod yon grogs su 'khyer/ zhes/ bza' btung*/ gdan gsol sdod gnas sogs nye bar longs spyad bya thams cad la yang*/ phal pa rnams kyi ltar med la rtsol sgrub dang*/ yod la sred zhen drag pos kun nas bcings pa ma yin par zhen med sred bral du spyad cing*/ don dam par chos nyid la chos nyid rol ba dang*/ kun rdzob ltar yang lha dang bla ma mchod pa'i tshul gyis longs spyad/ srod la dbang po gzhi la bsdu/ zhes/ gnyid du 'gro khar yang rnam rtog 'khrul phyir lug 150)rgyud du mi 'brang bar/ gdod ma'i gzhi'am gnyug ma ma bcos khyab gdal gyi ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ nam gung shes bya bum par gzhug

ces pa/ 'di skabs su gsar rnying gi man ngag rnams las shes bya bum 'jug gi thabs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig mchis mod kyang*/ 'dir ni/ snang mched thob gsum gyi shes bya rnams spros bral chos nyid kyi bum pa rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa 'od gsal stong pa chen po'i klong du gzhug bya 'jug byed kyi mtshan ma bral bar 'jog pa nyid dang*/ de'i thabs kyi yan lag tu/ snying gar 'od kyi theg le'i nang na bla ma'i sku gsal ba las gzhan du ma yengs par gnyid du 'gro ba la bslab/ tho rangs ye shes rang gsal gdab/ ces pas/ gnyid las sad pa'i tshe yang rnam rtog 'khrul 151)pa'i mdun mi bsu bar/ gong gi mnyam bzhag gi ngo bo'i ye shes la 'phro 'thud/ 'chi khar chos nyid zang thal btang*/ zhes pas/ nam 'chi'i dus la babs pa'i tshe yang*/ ci drag gang drag tsab tsub kyi blo mang mi bya bar/ skye 'chi rang snang du shes pas/ 'pho bya 'pho byed kyi mtshan ma'i dmigs pa la ma ltos par/ rang rig stong gsal chos nyid kyi ngang la dgag sgrub chags thogs med par zang thal du la zlos pas/ gzhi lam gyi 'od gsal gnyis po chu sna rgya mtshor 'dres pa'am/ bum chag nam mkha' phyi nang 'dres pa ltar 'gyur ba la 'bad pa nyid de/ de ltar phyag chen yi ge bzhi pa'i nyams len gyi gnad don thams cad 'di dag tu 'du la/ gal te gang zag gsar bu dag 'di'i sgo nas dang por 'khrid par lta bu la ni/ sngon du 'gro 152)ba'i rim pa dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang*/ mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras sogs bsam pa dang*/ skyabs sems/ yig brgya/ maṇḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom thabs rnams phyag chen gyi khrid rim spyi khyab ltar/ bla mas legs par 'chad cing*/ slob mas kyang g.yas chung zhor chos zhus lo thob lor ma song bar/ re re nas nan chags su bsgom pa ni gal po che'i gnad lags pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'di nyid nyams len dngos kyi tshe/ thun mgor mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag sku bzhi dbyer med kyi go 'phang la 'god phyir kho nar bdag nyams len zab mo la 'jug par bgyi'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed dang*/

thun gyi mjug tu de ltar myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig snyam pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ 'dod yon lam gnyis khyer gyi dus su/ phung khams skye mched thams cad 153)gdod nas lha sngags su lhun gyi grub par shes pa'i bskyed rim dang*/ shes bya bum 'jug gi dus su snying khar bla ma bsgom pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ phyag chen dngos dang bcas pa rnams la brtson pas ni/ byang chub sems dang yid dam lha// bla ma phyag rgya chen po dang*// bsngo ba'i chos kyi nyams su blangs/ zhes pa'i lam zab mo lnga ldan kyang 'dir tshang bar 'gyur tshe/ phyag rgya chen po seṅge 'dra yang lnga ldan med na mig med yin/ zhes pa'i skyon yang mi 'byung ba ste/ gnad don kun 'dus 'di lta bu la nyams bzhes ye shes kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad pas/ srid pa'i drwa ba gcod par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje 'chang chen tello nā ro nas// chos kyi rgyal po gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i bar// zung 'jug brgyud pa'i byin rlabs 154)las 'ongs pa'i// gdams ngag dri med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang 'di// sprul pa'i skyes mchog mi pham mgon nyid la// thugs dam bogs 'don grogs su phul ba 'di'i// dge bas mkha' khyab 'gro ba ma lus kyang*// 'di don mngon gyur rdzogs pa'i byang chub shog ces spong ba pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis rgod phug mya ngan med pa'i nags khrod du yi ger bkod pa'o// dge'o//
